identity.operation: Normalize boundary markers with UTF8PROC_CHARBOUND and UTF8PROC_STRIPCC.
identity.condition: A stripped control follows a boundary marker while other text survives.
identity.capability: Retain markers for surviving text and remove the marker immediately before the stripped control.
identity.consequence: A marker is lost from surviving text or remains before the stripped control.
